lines.text: The elder prays for Gaius's health and has no greater joy than hearing his children walk in the truth.
The elder calls Gaius faithful to the brothers, strangers to him, who testified to the church about his love.
The brothers went out on behalf of the Name, accepting nothing from the Samaritans, so we ought to support them.
Diotrephes, who loves to be first, refuses to welcome the brothers and forbids others, putting them out of the church.
Demetrius has a good testimony from everyone, and the elder hopes to see Gaius face to face, not use scrolls.
